crossRefs.note: Now Solomon decided to build a house for Yahweh’s name, and a house for his kingdom.
But Yahweh said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it…
Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to Yahweh, twenty two thousand head of cattle…
Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.
You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of Yahweh our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.
translations.bsb: Behold, I am about to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God to dedicate to Him for burning fragrant incense before Him, for displaying the showbread continuously, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening as well as on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts of the LORD our God. This is ordained for Israel forever.
translations.kjv: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.
translations.asv: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of Jehovah my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him incense of sweet spices, and for the continual showbread, and for the burnt-offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the set feasts of Jehovah our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.
